vb_textbox.text: I've played this game and I've tried multiple different options to try and get the best points. I honestly think it's random and that you should go with your best instincts. The advice given to me was that the taller gnomes produce more points and perhaps the colour of the baskets make a difference. This might be the case, but I couldn't see a pattern when I played. I tried matching the basket colours with the gnomes but I didn't see any patterns. Hopefully you can work it out better than me! I think the red baskets may give the most mushrooms? Try to be quick with your responses, and good luck and have fun!
